name: Mu3e detector
notes: technology_classes uses 'other': none of the ontology's listed classes (lar_tpc, water_cherenkov, ..., gaseous_tpc, emulsion, tracking_calorimeter, haloscope, spectrometer, other) names a silicon-pixel HV-MAPS tracker specifically; Mu3e's tracker is solid-state silicon, not a gas TPC, so 'gaseous_tpc' was rejected in favour of 'other'.

placements.note: site:psi-villigen is owned by the 'facilities' Wave-3 workstream and had not landed in data/atlas/sites/ as of this session; this is an expected dangling reference.

summary.plain: A very thin, high-speed silicon camera built from custom pixel chips, combined with fast timing detectors, being assembled at the Paul Scherrer Institute to catch three particles flying apart from a single muon.
summary.technical: Multi-layer HV-MAPS silicon pixel tracker (vertex + outer tracking layers; third layer installed 2026-09) combined with scintillating-fibre and scintillating-tile timing systems, on the PSI HiMB/piE5 beamline. Under construction; no data yet.

technology.quote: To this aim, we use innovative high-voltage monolithic active pixel sensors (HV-MAPS)
technology.value: Ultra-thin silicon pixel tracker built from high-voltage monolithic active pixel sensors (HV-MAPS), combined with scintillating-fibre and scintillating-tile timing detectors
